axis_supply.supply_status: Adequate for defensive siege operations, strained for offensive operations. Primary constraint: Extended supply line from Tripoli (800+ km) vulnerable to British naval/air interdiction. Water supply critical issue in desert environment. Vehicle maintenance hampered by chronic spare parts shortages and desert wear. Artillery replacement (1º Regiment for destroyed 55º Regiment May 1941) required significant logistics coordination.

allied_supply.supply_status: Adequate for East Africa campaign operations in Q2 1941. Division operating in Ethiopian highlands following capture of Addis Ababa (April 6). Supply lines from Kenya via captured Italian depots. Primary constraint: long distance from South African ports (Mombasa 1200km). Division preparing for redeployment to Egypt in late Q2/early Q3 1941.
